evals.prompt: Review the existing MDE rental results screen: filter chips are unclear, card and map selection are hard to follow, and no-match feedback is confusing. Recommend the smallest UX corrections using the current components. Do not edit code.
evals.expected_output: Audits the existing rental discovery journey and relevant states, separates observed problems from assumptions, proposes specific small fixes using current components and design tokens, and identifies browser/mobile verification without starting a redesign.

evals.prompt: Audit the existing MDE event-ticket checkout screen on mobile. Loading and payment-error feedback are confusing; evaluate primary actions and recovery states without redesigning the page or changing payments.
evals.expected_output: Identifies user-impacting checkout UX problems and recovery states, preserves payment truth, proposes focused copy/layout fixes, and describes appropriate mobile/keyboard and safe checkout checks.

evals.prompt: Review the current Ask MDE chat-and-map screen for keyboard focus, screen-reader labels, empty search results, and responsive panel behavior; give a focused UX audit only, not a new visual identity.
evals.expected_output: Examines the existing user journey and state matrix, identifies verifiable accessibility and responsive usability findings, reuses MDE UI primitives, and distinguishes browser proof from backend action proof.

evals.prompt: Create a brand-new MDE operator dashboard with a distinctive visual composition, premium typography hierarchy, and a completely new page layout. Design the new interface, not an audit of an existing screen; do not edit code yet.
evals.expected_output: Routes substantial new-screen visual design to frontend-design rather than using the existing-screen uiux audit skill; preserves MDE design tokens unless the brief explicitly requests rebranding.

evals.prompt: Fix the Supabase RLS policy for rental leads because another user can read private viewing requests. This is a database authorization defect, not a screen redesign. Diagnose the policy without making changes.
evals.expected_output: Routes database RLS/security ownership to supabase and avoids treating a tenant-isolation failure as a cosmetic UIUX task.

evals.prompt: Run the existing Playwright browser tests for the signed-in rental viewing journey and report the actual pass/fail evidence. Do not propose visual changes; this is test execution only.
evals.expected_output: Routes browser test execution to e2e instead of uiux; reports real test evidence rather than asserting a visual opinion.
